Latest AI & Tech stories

AI & Tech

Fri Nov 13ai-tech

Microsoft 365 outage stretches into a second day

Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other Microsoft 365 services were disrupted worldwide from Thursday, and Microsoft said on Friday that recovery was progressing, though some users still faced delayed email and intermittent access.

Thu Nov 12ai-tech

Jensen Huang quits as Nvidia CEO; Kress interim

Nvidia's board accepted the resignation effective immediately and named director Harvey Jones its first chair.

Thu Nov 12ai-tech

Gemini 4 Hydrogen goes live in Google Search

Google calls it Search's biggest model upgrade yet, aimed at multi-part questions with more links and visual answers.

Thu Nov 12ai-tech

Nvidia shares slide as board weighs Huang's future

Reuters said the board met to decide Huang's future; no outcome had been announced and shares fell premarket.

Wed Nov 11ai-tech

UK chipmaker Fractile raises $720M for AI inference

Thrive, Founders Fund, Lightspeed and Redpoint led the Series C, with the UK's Sovereign AI fund joining at a valuation above £5B.

Wed Nov 11ai-tech

CoreWeave Q3 revenue up 168% to $3.66B

Backlog reached $132.5B, but the AI cloud provider still lost $709M as net interest costs hit $846M. It's an early read on AI infrastructure spending after heavy selling in AI stocks.

Wed Nov 11ai-tech

Alibaba cleared to spin off chip unit T-Head

T-Head, which makes data center AI chips, filed confidentially on Sept. 11.

Tue Nov 10ai-tech

Anthropic sets IPO range at $70-$78, up to $1.4T

The amended S-1 offers 825M shares on Nasdaq as ANT, plus a $26B private sale to Google, Nvidia and five other chip and cloud firms.

Tue Nov 10ai-tech

NY opens AI safety registry; sign-up due Jan 1

The RAISE Act portal covers frontier AI developers with over $500M in revenue.

Mon Nov 9ai-tech

Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2, gated Mythos 5.2

Both run on one model priced at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens.

Mon Nov 9ai-tech

Google adds TPU 8tx and 8i Max to its 8th-gen lineup

8tx keeps data and model weights isolated in hardware during use, aimed at banks and governments; 8i Max doubles TPU 8i's memory bandwidth.

Sun Nov 8ai-tech

Nvidia board opens probe after Huang spy reports

Independent directors and outside counsel will review reports that CEO Jensen Huang was a foreign spy target; the board sees no sign secrets were compromised.

Sun Nov 8ai-tech

Elvis rights holders, Eminem publisher sue Suno

Two federal suits accuse the AI music app of mimicking the artists; the Presley case cites Tennessee's 2024 ELVIS Act on voice cloning.

Fri Nov 6ai-tech

Fox completes $22B acquisition of Roku

Fox closed its Roku purchase Nov. 6; Roku shares cease Nasdaq trading.

Fri Nov 6ai-tech

Tesla to wind down Cybertruck in mid-2027

Elon Musk said on X that Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Gigafactory Texas around mid-2027 to make room for more Cybercab output.

Thu Nov 5ai-tech

Claude adds read-only Personal Finance tool

US Pro, Max and Ultra users can link bank and card accounts via Plaid in a beta rolling out this week; Claude can't move money.

Thu Nov 5ai-tech

Dropbox to acquire Tigris Data for $350M

The cash deal backs DBX Agent Cloud, S3-compatible storage Dropbox will offer developers building AI apps and agents, beyond its own file app.

Thu Nov 5ai-tech

Amazon adds Uber Eats to Prime, $0 fee over $25

US Prime members can now order Uber Eats inside Amazon's app with no Uber account, as Amazon's Grubhub+ perk ends.

Thu Nov 5ai-tech

Sony Q2 net income up 44% to ¥449.6B

Sales grew 10% to ¥3.43T for July to September, helped by PlayStation and the Spider-Man: Brand New Day film.

Wed Nov 4ai-tech

OpenAI to acquire Pierre, maker of Codex tools

Pierre runs Code Storage and builds the open-source Trees and Diffs libraries already used in the Codex app.

Wed Nov 4ai-tech

AMD Q3 revenue hits record $13.4B, up 45%

Data center sales nearly doubled to $8.5B while gaming fell 40% to $773M. AMD guided Q4 revenue to about $17B, plus or minus 3%, roughly 66% above a year earlier.

Wed Nov 4ai-tech

Canva cuts 22% of staff

CEO Melanie Perkins told staff growth slowed for the first time in a decade; TechCrunch puts the cuts at 1,271 people.

Mon Nov 2ai-tech

Apple Q4 revenue hits record $114.5B, up 12%

iPhone and Services set records and EPS rose 14% to $2.10 in the quarter of the iPhone 18 Pro launch. iPhone Duo preorders aren't included; a $0.27 dividend is payable Nov 16.

Mon Nov 2ai-tech

Anthropic posts $567M Q3 operating loss

Its amended S-1 shows Q3 revenue near $17B, up 47% from Q2 vs 144% the prior quarter; costly short-term compute erased a $974M Q2 operating profit.

Mon Nov 2ai-tech

NYT, three papers sue Brave over AI scraping

Suits in Manhattan federal court allege Brave copied paywalled articles and sold index access to AI firms; Brave hasn't responded.

Mon Nov 2ai-tech

Marvell to acquire Lumentum in $115B all-stock deal

Lumentum holders get 4.5 Marvell shares each, about a 23.9% premium.

Fri Oct 30ai-tech

GM to pay $220M over driver data sales

Attorneys general for 35 states and DC alleged GM sold Smart Driver data to brokers who passed it to insurers.

Fri Oct 30ai-tech

Google satellite runs first AI prompt in orbit

Google's Suncatcher prototype, launched Oct 1, ran its Gemma 4 model on TPU chips to answer a prompt.

Fri Oct 30ai-tech

Waymo and Toyota to test self-driving bZ4X fleet in Japan in 2027

Toyota will build the cars with Waymo's hardware at its Takaoka plant, with the UK and other Waymo markets to follow.

Wed Oct 28ai-tech

Microsoft puts Azure revenue at $33.2B

In its first dollar disclosure, Microsoft said Azure grew 48% from a year earlier in the July-September quarter, about 36% of total revenue of $92.3B.

modals.2026-10-22-ai-tech-1:
Thursday · Oct 22, 2026 · AI & Tech Digest · ai

OpenAI opens its Decisions API to all developers

OpenAI made its Decisions API generally available on Thursday, a service that answers bounded questions (a yes/no probability, a pick from a fixed list, or a rubric score) instead of generating free text. It runs on GPT-6 Luna and costs $0.10 per million input tokens ($0.01 cached), with no charge for output tokens. Since its public beta, OpenAI added GPT-Live voice integration, image and JSON inputs, US and EU processing, and a limit of 400 questions per request.

Why it matters: Apps and AI agents make many small routing and classification calls, and running each through a full chat model adds delay. OpenAI now offers a separate endpoint for these calls. Early users included Box, Datadog, Ramp and Speak, and Speak says its time between actions fell from 1.4 seconds to 0.13 seconds in its own testing. These speed figures come from OpenAI and its customers, not independent tests.

References

  1. Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
    OpenAI · openai.com · 2026-10-22
  2. OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
    TechCrunch · techcrunch.com · 2026-10-22

Ukraine disputes Musk's claim that its military broke Starlink's terms

Musk wrote on X on Saturday that Ukraine's military "violated Starlink terms of service" by using it for offensive drone strikes and that "that loophole was closed last week," the BBC reported. Serhii Beskrestnov, a defense technology adviser to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said existing restrictions made such use "physically impossible," CNBC and AP reported.

Beskrestnov said drones using civilian Starlink in Ukraine have had a speed cap of 70 to 90 km/h and that the service does not work over Russia. Ukrainian officials said speed caps on Starlink and SpaceX's military-focused Starshield service were lifted Saturday after disruptions they said hampered air defenses.

Why it matters: Ukraine relies on SpaceX satellite links for wartime communications, and the dispute raises questions about who decides its access.
